title: Trace Sheriff — Agent Timeline Forensics

checks.name: fixture analysis
checks.command: bun run src/cli.ts analyze fixtures/sample.jsonl --json out/summary.json --html report.html
checks.details: The fixture produced terminal, JSON, and HTML output.

summary: Trace Sheriff streams JSONL agent logs, reconstructs per-session timelines (spans, idle gaps, tool concurrency), and emits terminal, deterministic JSON, and a self-contained HTML forensics report without crashing on malformed lines.
